content: Apple Developer Forums confirm MKLocalSearch/MKReverseGeocodingRequest enforces an undocumented but observed ~50 requests/60s throttle, returning MKError.loadingThrottled ('Throttled ... will reset in X seconds') once exceeded; Apple does not document the exact number and advises apps to discover it empirically. No evidence found that being unsigned/unbundled changes the limit, but this repo's own closed #17 already flagged a 'bundle-id/throttling caveat... from a bare python process' as a live open question, not yet resolved on device.
